story_targets.narrative_hook: Zidane's legendary headbutt in his final match — the most infamous World Cup final moment of all time

events.description: Zidane scores a Panenka-style penalty that clips the crossbar and goes in. France 1-0 Italy. Malouda was fouled by Materazzi in the box
Materazzi rises highest to head in a Pirlo corner. Italy 1-1 France. The giant defender atones for conceding the penalty
Half time. Italy 1-1 France. An intense, tactical first half with both sides exchanging blows
Toni heads against the crossbar for Italy. Pirlo's delivery causing France constant problems
Toni has a goal disallowed for a borderline push. Italy pushing hard for a winner
Full time. Italy 1-1 France. Extra time to be played. Both teams exhausted but the drama is only beginning
Zidane forces a brilliant save from Buffon with a powerful header. The Juventus keeper at his best
Zidane headbutts Materazzi in the chest after an exchange of words. Sent off in his final professional match. One of the most iconic moments in football history
Zidane walks past the World Cup trophy on his way to the tunnel after being sent off. The image of a fallen legend
Extra time full time. Italy 1-1 France. Penalty shootout awaits after an epic match
Pirlo scores Italy's first penalty. Calm and composed for the regista
Wiltord scores France's first penalty. Shootout tied 1-1
Materazzi scores Italy's second penalty. The unlikely hero converts
Barthez saves Trezeguet's penalty — it hits the crossbar. France 1-2 Italy in shootout
De Rossi scores Italy's third penalty. Italy 3-1 in shootout
Del Piero scores Italy's fourth penalty. Ice cold from the Juventus legend
Grosso scores the winning penalty. Italy win the World Cup 5-3 on penalties. Azzurri champions for the fourth time
Cannavaro lifts the World Cup trophy for Italy. The Azzurri celebrate their fourth world title in front of the world
